Container.Name: Invoicery
Container.Overview: Invoicery is a self-hosted boutique workshop for crafting invoices, tracking expenses, managing inventory, and generating automated Indian GST (GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B) tax reports. Built with Bun, SQLite, and vanilla modern web tech, featuring offline-first local data ownership, automated interstate/intrastate tax routing, backup & restore, and a clean dark-mode UI.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: invoicery invoice billing gst gstr1 gstr3b accounting boutique receipt tax finance
Container.Changes: [Initial Release] - Official Unraid template for Invoicery.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port used by the Invoicery web interface.

Config.Name: Data Storage Path
Config.Description: Persistent directory for storing Invoicery SQLite database (billing.db).

Config.Name: Attachments Storage Path
Config.Description: Persistent directory for storing invoice PDFs and receipt uploads.

Config.Name: HOST
Config.Description: Network binding address (set to 0.0.0.0 to allow access from local network).

Config.Name: DB_PATH
Config.Description: Path to SQLite database file inside container.
